story: A meteor or alien tech: Harvard professor plans UFO expedition
text: He has an interview with Lex Fridman here: [VIDEO] I haven't listened to the whole thing, but he seems to think that aliens visiting our solar system is likely enough that it makes sense to look for. He falls short of the confident certainty I usually expect from cranks though, he's talking about investigating possibilities. I think he's eccentric, but I wouldn't call him a crank.

story: Discovery of Spherules of Likely Extrasolar Composition in the Pacific Ocean [pdf]
text: For context, this is a paper by Avi Loeb [1,2], the "Oumuamua is an interstellar spaceship" researcher. In this paper, Avi explores a possible interstellar origin meteorite. He used data from US air defence senors that had tracked a highly unusual atmospheric entry nearly a decade ago. This object was theorized as a possible extrasolar trajectory meteorite when it had entered the earth's atmosphere. [3,4] Avi recently chartered a research expedition in an attempt to dredge up samples of this meteorite from the sea floor. [1] [LINK] [2] [VIDEO] [3] [LINK] [4] [LINK]
